name: Aoyama Kotoha
source:
Younger sister of the protagonist. Goes to the same school, as an underclassman. 

Her relationship with her older brother is not very good, a bit like cold war.

Actually loves the protagonist very much and doesn't want to hand him over to any other woman.

Is childhood friends with Miki but due to the case of her older brother, has become somewhat estranged with her.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=727030]Getchu[/url]]
